nodes.text:
Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) can cause respiratory disease.
HMPV spreads from person to person or surfaces to person.
Symptoms include cough, fever, nasal congestion, and shortness of breath. Treatment is symptomatic & routine prevention strategies need to be followed.

Dr Aejaz
